items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I think Lorraine was then interceding for Dizzy to go with William Morris

ctx.x: So he came back by and he told me this, I felt very bad. I said, well, hey man, can you take your job back, he said, no, you keep that job, I'm going to get another job. So in other words I stayed there and I worked and then after the Moon Glow closed Oscar Pettiford felt that he wanted to go get his own group and so Dizzy and I said okay we'll stick together. So I was the business manager and Dizzy Gillespie was the musical director, and we went across the street to the Yacht Club and took a group in there. And…

All right, after we -- when we were in the Yacht Club then I think Lorraine was then interceding for Dizzy to go with William Morris, and any way he signed up with William Morris. But before he did you know the street was full of guys looking for recordings, you know, and of course one of the main guys was Timmy Rosenkrantz. You know, Timmy Rosenkrantz was a beautiful guy. He was actually royalty.
